claims.author: musaHaruna
claims.harm: Allowing separate interrupt arguments for ChainstateManager and BlockManager allows a mismatch where interrupting only storage causes block-index loading to return false and report a spurious block database error.
claims.quote: Current callers already share the same signal, but the constructor allows different ones. For example, if only storage’s signal is interrupted, block-index loading can return `false` because it was asked to stop. The chainstate loader then checks `chainman.m_interrupt`. If that separate signal is still clear, it reports “Error loading block database”, even though the database is healthy.
